scan: 5 curve types × 15 Ogg primes; animation runs over p (higher p ⇒ more points ⇒ richer support)

bar = #points whose coordinate is divisible by prime q

bar = #points that are B-smooth (all coord primes ≤ B)

coherence (all weight on one prime) at low p → net decoherence (weight spreads) at high p
D · Hilbert locality map of the scan
consecutive Ogg primes stay adjacent (locality preserved)
E · hypersphere projection
